figures.caption: Fig. 3: Overview of the proposed Mask-to-OBB (M2O) loss. The predicted mask s is projected into the OBB space to preserve spatial extent and orientation while suppressing fine-grained shape details. The projected representation is aligned with the OBB label y, enabling geometry-consistent learning from OBB annotations.
